incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty incident PD-5981 fired (priority: P1) - metrics: redis-accept-queue > 5000, pg-connections near max
luis-pd: Acked. On-call: @alice
alice: I'm looking. seeing accept queue climb on redis-hosts in eu-west-1, tail of `redis:clients` shows `maxclients` approaching 10000.
carla-support: Customer reports: several requests returning 504/429 around 12:03 UTC, spike in webhooks. List of affected customers in the ticket: CUST-422, CUST-431.
alice: Initial hypothesis: upstream traffic flood -> redis acceptqueue -> connection storm -> app pool exhaustion -> PG connections backlog. Rolling reconnects visible in logs.
ben: Can we rate-limit the webhook consumer? If we set `X-Rate-Limit` for the ingress workers to 100r/s it may reduce pressure.
alice: Trying a temporary ingress throttling via feature-flag. Command:
```
# toggle feature flag for webhook ingress
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $FLAG' https://admin-api/flags/webhook-ingress/throttle -d '{"rate":100}'
```
(doing now)
david-sre: Rebalancing redis clients: increasing `maxclients` on nodes is risky. Suggest enabling `client-output-buffer-limit` adjustments and failing noisy producers.
alice: FLAG toggle applied. Observing accepted connections drop from 6k -> 2k in ~20s. Latency for API endpoints dropping from 1200ms -> 420ms.
luis-pd: PD: escalation path ready if recovery fails. Who will take postmortem?
carla-support: Notifying top 5 affected customers with an initial incident note.
ben: Next step: throttle ingress permanently while we stabilize and schedule a patch to add backpressure on webhook sender side.
alice: Handoff: I need to go offline for a deploy. Handing to @ben for follow-up and postmortem. Key signals to watch: redis acceptqueue, pg active connections, 5xx rate, customer ticket count.
ben: Ack. I'll continue monitoring and create the mitigation runbook and postmortem draft.
incident-bot: PD-5981 status: acknowledged by luis-pd at 1801112230, assigned to alice -> ben. Incident severity P1 -> mitigated state pending.
carla-support: Updated support ticket and sent ETA to customers: "we're throttling ingress and investigating; next update in 30m".
ben: Creating a follow-up Jira: WEBHOOK-1772 "Ingress backpressure + graceful retry" and assigning to infra.
alice: Thanks all. Reopen here if we see any regression. :thumbsup:
